description: The federal income tax rate schedule for tax year 2027 (or 2026) from IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35: the seven brackets (10, 12, 22, 24, 32, 35, 37 percent) for single, married filing jointly, married filing separately and head of household, or estates and trusts, with the tax at the bottom of each bracket and the change in each threshold from the other year. A model cannot know the 2027 numbers from training. Thresholds apply to taxable income after the deduction.

compare.description: Include the other year for comparison. Default true.

filing_status.description: One filing status. Omit for the four individual statuses.

name: get_tax_brackets
title: Get 2027 tax brackets
